fields.name: ShardKeyOrleansSerializer<...> Orleans codec family
fields.contract: For each ShardKey arity 1, 2, 3, and 4 whose generic arguments implement IComparable, ShardKeyOrleansSerializer<...> exposes Orleans IFieldCodec and IDeepCopier surfaces. DeepCopy rebuilds the same-arity ShardKey from its byte representation. WriteField first delegates reference values to Orleans reference handling; otherwise it writes a LengthPrefixed field whose payload is the key's ToArray bytes preceded by one byte containing that payload length. ReadValue reads a reference field through Orleans reference handling; otherwise it requires a LengthPrefixed wire type, reads one length byte and that many bytes, rebuilds the same-arity ShardKey, and records the rebuilt object in the reader session.
